span.p:
The pipeline waits at each manual step as long as you need.
Or quit and resume later: --from-step 1 after the lyrics,
--from-step 4 after Aegisub.

div.style: color: rgb(9, 4, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(216, 221, 218) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(9, 4, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Start a Track
run_pipeline.py with a track ID and a YouTube link
you input the track's details when asked
(artist, title, album, year, genre)

div.style: color: rgb(9, 4, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Step 0 · Set Up the Track
creates the folder · downloads the audio
starts _lyr.txt

div.style: color: rgb(9, 4, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Paste the Lyrics into _lyr.txt
you input the lyrics, e.g. from Genius
keep [Section] headers · BG lines in (parentheses)
every line within the 48-character ruler

div.style: color: rgb(9, 4, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Steps 1 to 3 · First Draft
separate the vocals · align the lyrics to them
write _subs.ass with a timing for every syllable

div.style: color: rgb(9, 4, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Tap Tool (btk_tap.html, in a browser)
tap along with J and K, one tap per syllable
about 10 minutes · export _subs-tap.ass

div.style: color: rgb(216, 221, 218) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(9, 4, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Aegisub
fix flagged lines · place the END marker
save _subs-timed.ass · apply the styles
run the macro once · save _subs-final.ass

div.style: color: rgb(9, 4, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Steps 4 to 7 · Finish
title cards · karaoke video · final splice
YouTube title, description, tags and thumbnail

div.style: color: rgb(9, 4, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Watch It, Then Upload
_final.mp4, with _yt_copy.txt and _thumb.png
